brief 010 follow-up, café seating (Aster, 2026-10-15): the café's seats are the chairs of the café sets the world draws on the block's tables (kind seat, 24) with 24 standing points beside the café (kind stand); people are given them by person id, one to a seat at a time and then the nearest standing points, so every stop at a seat changes place and its walk times; the café's customers' side for a regular tie is a pre-shift stop at one of them (a meal or an evening at a chair is a customer's, no regular's), which moves the tie draws; P-13 is new; P-5 holds a chair only by a zone that bars tables. Person ids, names, jobs and homes do not move

Suture QA 2026-10-15: the need draw has no fallback to the whole needs list (a person with none of their own row's needs is an expansion error; a temperament no row need can reach is drawn again within the row, and the mix repair picks only temperaments a need can reach); P-3 holds each need to the person's own row; a regular tie never points at the person's own employer (the expander's pool and P-7); the review reports the row cap on the people beside the weights. Ties and needs of the persons whose pools moved are drawn again
